summary.en: Show routed member questions as silent receiving sessions with Decision Briefs and focused reference documents.
summary.zh: 将定向成员提问显示为静默接收 Session，并呈现决策简报与聚焦参考文档。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: The planner follows shared Client Runtime and presentation packages, but Mobile imports unchanged presentation faces and does not compose the Web member-question plugin or receiving-session wire path.

The planner follows shared lockfile and aggregate build inputs; the new Project Membership browser and HTTP consumers are not composed into apps/platform, and no Platform image or deployment input changes.
